title: polarPattern
body:
## polarPattern

Repeat one additive or subtractive sketch feature around a Body origin axis. count includes the original. For angle360 degrees, instances are evenly distributed without duplicating the first position; for a partial angle, it is the first-to-last span. This supports bolt-circle intent with native editable occurrences and angle; each result must remain one valid solid.

Native binding: `PartDesign::PolarPattern`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | one node | yes | `solid` |
| `feature` | one node | yes | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `angle` | Positive sweep in degrees, at most360 and default360. A full-turn polar pattern distributes count instances around a circle; a partial pattern uses a first-to-last angular span. Revolved material must remain geometrically valid. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":360}` | `360` |
| `count` | Number of feature occurrences including the original, from2 to100. A pattern does not implicitly duplicate the entire Body; choose the original material-changing feature explicitly. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":2,"maximum":100}` | `4` |
| `axis` | Body origin X/Y/Z rotation axis, default Z. For revolve/groove a same-Body datumAxis input supplies an arbitrary editable axis instead; patterns currently use origin axes only. | `{"type":"enum","values":["X","Y","Z"]}` | `"Z"` |
